svg.title: Organ-stratified H&E fold-localization performance
svg.desc: Heatmap of positive-field macro Dice for seven methods across brain, kidney, liver, small intestine, and testis.

g.text: Focused 0–0.85 color scale; 42–57 positive fields and 3–9 positive source-slide groups per organ
